name: Cheesy Portobello Mushroom Burger with Blueberry BBQ Sauce & Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice one lemon into a blender. (Reserve remaining lemon for the dressing.)
Peel garlic; add to the blender along with blueberries, ketchup, sugar, soy sauce, and spices. Blend on high until very smooth, about 1 minute. Set BBQ sauce aside.
Remove stems from the mushrooms and carefully scrape out the gills; place on a plate.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel and slice onion crosswise into ¼-inch thick rings; add to the plate with the mushrooms. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add the veggies and grill, undisturbed, until tender and lightly charred on one side, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve plate for later use.)
While the veggies are grilling, thinly slice cheese.

When the veggies are charred on one side, flip, then top each mushroom with cheese; continue to grill until veggies are tender and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes more. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.
Meanwhile, juice the remaining lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Halve tomatoes and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocado; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl along with mixed greens and almonds; toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Spread half of the BBQ sauce over the bottom half of each bun; layer with mushrooms, onions, and remaining sauce. Close with the top half of each bun.
To serve, divide burgers and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
